s: A cozy carpenter's workshop with wood shavings and hand tools on the wall; a small wooden puppet boy in a red vest and feathered cap sits on the workbench, one hand touching an already very long nose that curves out of frame, eyes shifted sideways with a guilty giggle; a white-bearded old woodworker in a leather apron leans back, blinking in astonishment. Warm lamplight, sawdust, playful mood.

A rose garden inside a castle courtyard; a young woman in a simple blue dress kneels to tend a climbing rose, smiling gently; beside her a large gentle beast with soft brown fur and kind eyes holds a watering can awkwardly in both paws, ears tilted forward, a small proud smile on his face. Stone walls, climbing roses, warm afternoon light, tender atmosphere.

A moonlit country road; four animals form a tower: a grey donkey at the base, a brown dog on its back, a striped cat on the dog, and a red rooster on top with beak open mid-crow. They sing with great enthusiasm, eyes shut, chests out; behind them a cottage window glows, and two robbers are already scrambling out the door. Blue night, warm window light, comic energy.

A grand ballroom staircase with marble steps; a young woman in a shimmering pale-blue ball gown with glass slippers descends, one hand on the rail, the other lifted in a hurried farewell gesture, expression joyful and flustered; a clock on the wall shows nearly midnight; a young prince in a white and gold coat reaches up the stairs after her. Chandeliers, warm golden light, motion and shimmer.

A palace street during a parade; a stout emperor in a crown and fancy shoes walks with chest puffed and chin high, wearing nothing but his undergarments, one hand imperiously raised; behind him two smirking tailors in striped coats bow; courtiers line the way clapping with strained polite smiles; in the front row a small girl points at him, mouth wide open in honest laughter. Bright festive bunting, comic tone.

A palace balcony overlooking a crowd; an emperor in a tall crown strides forward with great dignity, completely bare except for small undergarments, one hand resting on an invisible cloak edge; behind him two courtiers in fine robes exchange nervous glances, one pressing a hand to his mouth; below, a child in the crowd tugs at a parent's sleeve and points, laughing. Colourful banners, sunlight, comic reveal.

A stormy Russian seashore at dusk; an old fisherman in a patched coat and felt boots stands in a small wooden boat, one hand on the oar, shoulders slumped, expression weary and apologetic; before him a golden fish with bright eyes and a graceful tail rises from a swirl of dark water, mouth open as if speaking; a low log cabin with carved window frames on the shore behind him. Wind, spray, dramatic mood.

A palace dining hall; a small green frog with a red bow sits calmly on the polished table beside a golden plate, front legs folded, big eyes polite and hopeful; a young princess in a pink gown leans back in her chair, nose wrinkled, hands raised in distaste; a king in a purple robe and crown frowns at her from the head of the table, one finger raised in reproach. Candles, silverware, warm light.

A forest path; a bright golden goose waddles forward with its head high, tail feathers gleaming; behind it a chain of people is stuck, each holding the coat or hand of the one ahead: a grinning young man, a startled baker covered in flour, a wailing milkmaid, and a plump landlord with arms flailing. Motion, dust, sunbeams, joyful chaos with a warm palette.

A clearing in a deep forest; a gingerbread cottage with frosting eaves, candy-cane doorposts and gumdrop roof tiles; a boy and girl in simple peasant clothes stand in front of it, the boy reaching for a candy window shutter, the girl pulling his sleeve with a worried frown; a shadowy old figure peers from the cottage door behind a curtain. Warm sunset, candy colours, hint of danger but not scary.

A bright country road; a cheerful young man in a simple brown tunic walks with a light bounce, hands empty and open, shoulders relaxed, laughing with his head tipped back; a little further along the road, a stone lies in the dust; behind him in the distance, a horse, a cow and a goose are visible with their new owners. Wildflowers, rolling hills, golden afternoon light, carefree mood.

A gigantic beanstalk rising through the clouds; a boy in a patched green tunic climbs a thick curling stem, one hand high, one foot braced, face determined but grinning; far above, a castle rests on a cloud bank; far below, a tiny cottage and a mother figure waving. Giant leaves, morning sun breaking through cloud, epic vertical composition.

A moonlit bedroom; a little girl in a white nightgown peeks from behind a curtain, eyes wide with delight; on the floor a circle of tulips, roses and lilies have come alive, dancing on tiny green stems, petals swirling like skirts, a few fireflies drifting above; a toy soldier and a doll watch from the shelf. Soft blue night, warm candle glow, whimsical mood.

A snowy street corner at night; a small girl in a thin shawl and worn shoes crouches against a wall, holding a bundle of matches, cheeks flushed, one hand cupping a single lit match whose warm glow lights her face with a dreamy smile; around her the falling snow, behind her a shop window with a warm golden glow; a barefoot doll in the snow at her side. Cool blue night with one circle of warmth.

A sunlit forest path; a cheerful little girl in a red hooded cape carries a covered basket on her arm, skipping along, one hand swinging; beside her walks a lean grey wolf with a friendly, too-wide smile, head tilted, one paw lifted as if chatting politely; behind them the path forks, one branch leading into dark trees. Bright greens, golden light, subtle tension masked as friendliness.

A cottage bedroom; a little girl in a red cloak and hood stands at the bedside, leaning in with a puzzled frown, one hand on her chin, head tilted as she studies the figure in the bed; the figure under the quilt has a grey furry muzzle, pointed ears and big eyes peeking over the blanket edge, wearing a frilly nightcap; a basket of cakes on the chair. Warm interior, comic tension.

A royal bedroom; a towering stack of twenty mattresses and quilts rises nearly to the ceiling, and on top a young woman sits up in a nightgown, hair tousled, rubbing her back with a pained expression, one hand pressed to a spot beneath her; beside the bed the queen in a dark green gown holds up a single pea between two fingers, smiling knowingly; a small ladder leans against the stack. Warm candlelight, comic exaggeration.

A country road; a confident orange tabby cat stands upright on hind legs, wearing tall brown leather boots and a feathered hat, one paw resting on a sword hilt, tail curled, a sly triumphant smile; behind him a startled young man in a plain tunic holds a straw hat to his chest; in the distance, a royal carriage and a field of haystacks. Bright daylight, swashbuckling charm.

A tall stone tower rising among cliffs, with one small window high up; a girl with an extremely long golden braid leans out of the window, the braid cascading down the tower wall almost to the ground; at the base a young man in a simple blue coat reaches up, hands on the braid, looking up with a hopeful grin. Wildflowers, morning mist, a few birds, romantic and warm.

A castle hall frozen in sleep; servants doze standing up with trays and brooms, a cat curled asleep on a rug, dust motes hanging in still sunbeams; a young woman in a rose-pink gown lies asleep on a velvet couch, hands folded, dark eyelashes on her cheeks; a young prince in a blue coat kneels beside her, gently touching her hand, expression full of wonder. Soft golden light, quiet magic.

A cozy cottage interior; seven small dwarfs in colourful pointed caps and patched tunics cluster around a young woman in a blue and yellow dress who holds a wooden spoon and a steaming pot, laughing warmly; one dwarf stands on a stool to reach the table, another sweeps with a too-big broom, another peeks from behind a chair. Wooden beams, hanging pots, warm firelight, cheerful bustle.

A mantelpiece at dusk; a small tin soldier with one leg stands perfectly straight at attention, rifle at his shoulder, uniform neat, single boot polished; beside him a paper ballerina in a pale pink dress balances on one toe, arms curved, spangles glittering; behind them a toy castle and a paper lake. Window light fades to blue, warm candle glimmer, tender poise.

A garden pond with lily pads; a small green frog sits on a lily pad holding a golden ball, big eyes hopeful; on the stone edge a young princess in a yellow dress kneels, one hand extended hesitantly, expression torn between reluctance and kindness; a golden crown rests in the grass beside her. Willows, dragonflies, soft green light, gentle mood.

A forest clearing at the edge of the trees; a young man in a plain tunic kneels to share bread and cheese with a bent old man in a grey cloak, whose eyes are kind beneath a wide hat; beside them a gleaming golden goose sits in the grass, head cocked; the young man's two older brothers can be seen walking away in the background, packs on their backs. Warm autumn light, generous mood.

A Chinese imperial palace chamber at night, with red lacquered columns and carved lattice screens; a small brown nightingale perches on the carved sill, beak open in song, chest feathers fluttering; inside the room an emperor in a gold dragon-embroidered robe and a black gauze crown reclines on cushions, one hand pressed to his heart, a tear on his cheek; on a table nearby a jewelled mechanical bird sits silent and dull. Moonlight through paper lattice, warm lantern glow, emotional contrast.

A royal bedchamber; a huge teetering stack of mattresses and featherbeds fills the room, a young woman in a white nightgown perched on top, frowning and rubbing her lower back; the queen in green holds up a tiny pea near a candle, one eyebrow raised with satisfaction, while a young prince peeks in from the doorway. Warm lamplight, comic tone.

A forest clearing at the edge of a lake; six white swans with golden crowns on their heads stand in a graceful line, wings half open; beside them a young woman in a simple grey dress kneels on the moss, sewing a shirt from pale star-shaped flowers with a bone needle, fingertips pricked red, expression resolute and gentle. Silver moonlight, water, quiet devotion.

A stormy paper sea on a tabletop; a small one-legged tin soldier stands upright in a folded paper boat that tilts on painted waves, rifle held tight, hat square, expression calm; rain-like drops fall from a watering can above; a paper ballerina watches from a windowsill in the background. Dramatic blue light, toy-scale adventure, brave mood.

Three cottages side by side on a green hill: one of golden straw, one of rough wood, one of solid red brick; a grey wolf in the foreground puffs out its cheeks with cheeks bulging, chest heaving, a great gust of wind drawn as swirling lines toward the straw house whose roof is peeling off; three little pigs in aprons peek from the brick house window. Bright sky, comic energy.

A dark dungeon cell with straw on the floor; a ragged soldier in an old uniform kneels and strikes a tinderbox, a spark flaring; from the smoke three enormous dogs with wide saucer eyes and big collars materialise, ears up, tails wagging, filling the cell; the soldier grins with delight rather than fear. Torchlight, smoke swirls, magical mischief.

A farmyard pond in early spring; a grey fluffy duckling stands at the water's edge, head lowered, watching its own reflection with a sad tilt; behind it, a group of sleek white ducklings turn their backs, and a haughty goose lifts its beak; a mother duck looks on with worried eyes; willow branches, soft grey-green light, gentle melancholy.

A rocky seaside cave at night; a young woman in a rough grey dress sits by a fire of driftwood, weaving a shirt from prickly nettles, hands red and scratched, jaw set, eyes tired but determined; beside her a pile of finished nettle shirts; through the cave mouth the sea glows silver; eleven swan silhouettes fly across the moon. Cool night palette, warm firelight, quiet endurance.

A patchwork quilt landscape of a farmhouse kitchen at giant scale; a tiny boy the size of a thumb stands on the rim of a teacup, one hand on his hip, the other raised in a confident wave, expression cheeky and bold; a huge spoon and a steaming teapot behind him; a cat's curious eye peers in from the corner. Warm homely light, whimsical scale play.

A giant flower blossom serving as a tiny house; a tiny girl in a petal dress with a leaf hat stands on the flower's edge, one hand lifted to the wind, looking up with wonder; beside her a small swallow with a bandaged wing rests on a leaf, head tilted affectionately; a world of enormous grass blades and flowers surrounds them. Warm golden-green light, dew drops, dreamy scale.

A country road with a horse-drawn cart; a tiny boy the size of a thumb sits inside the horse's ear, leaning out with both hands cupped around his mouth, shouting directions to the horse, cheeks puffed, expression gleeful; the farmer on the cart looks around in confusion, scratching his hat. Wheat field, blue sky, playful scale contrast.

A snowy forest clearing where a ring of twelve cloaked figures stands around a bonfire, each in a different colour robe from white to deep green to gold; in the centre one tall grey-bearded figure in a winter cloak gestures, and a patch of spring has bloomed through the snow at his feet: green shoots and red strawberries; a small girl in a thin coat kneels to gather them, eyes shining. Magical warm-cold contrast.

A still lake at spring dawn; a graceful white swan glides on the water, neck arched, wings slightly raised, head bent to look at its own reflection with a surprised, joyful expression; in the background a flock of swans flies up; on the shore, three ducks watch with open beaks. Soft pink and gold sky, mist on the water, hopeful mood.

A country road; a jaunty little tailor in a green coat and feathered cap stands with hands on hips, chest out, showing off a wide belt with seven small embroidered marks; around him scattered seven flies on the ground; a huge bearded giant looms behind, leaning down with wide eyes and open mouth, clearly alarmed. Bright daylight, comic scale contrast.

A rocky shore at dusk; a young woman in a plain dress kneels among nettles, weaving them into a shirt, hands bleeding, expression patient and steadfast; behind her eleven white swans with golden crowns wait on the water, necks turned toward her; a bundle of finished shirts rests on a rock. Grey-blue sea, low light, quiet sacrifice.

A cottage door inside; seven little white goats in simple clothes huddle together, one peeking into a big flour sack, another pointing at the door with a shaking hoof, all with wide eyes and open mouths; through the window the silhouette of a grey wolf with a chalk-white paw retreats; a kettle whistles on the stove, a sewing basket on the table. Warm interior, comic tension.
